Steps.Text: What the MOPR 4.x 'Satsuma driving mode' saved, and where it comes from. Seated in the Satsuma in Peraejaervi (parked, then driving 45 km/h on Teimo's route), the experimental options off. A/B (1 s blocks): the 4.x list switched off with SetActive (triggers, part pivots with the parts on them, part meshes); only the install triggers switched off; only their trigger colliders off; only their FSMs paused; the MiscParts renderers off (what not drawing them gives).
